DEF-441.title: Kadam Native url/image/cpc response array is validated as Push and its GET carrier is not decoded
DEF-441.expected: The documented Native response url is a valid click destination and should not be rejected for missing Push click_url. Paired format=native GET input supplies explicit Native placement intent.
DEF-441.actual: The array is routed through Push rules, producing feed.push.click_url_required at [0].click_url. The Native GET shape has no decoder, so paired format intent is lost. Browser measurement also records empty preview and absent expected creative identity.
notes: Related earlier groups are linked for consolidation; these are additional documented carriers, not additional independent root causes.
Coverage-closure cases extend this existing group; exact additional signatures and measured browser evidence are recorded per case, not counted as independent new defects.
Core, real HTTP and browser were measured separately during coverage closure. The browser shows an empty creative instead of the desired Native card; exact per-case signatures are pinned.
